title: Falcon Distribution
subtitle: Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence.

sections.heading: Executive summary
paragraphs: As of 2026-08-31, Falcon Distribution is an 8-suite industrial property in Indianapolis, IN. The certified rent roll shows 7 occupied and 1 vacant suite, totaling 176,060 SF with 87.5% occupancy by units and 87.5% by area. Underwritten stabilized income is based on all-suite scheduled rent from the certified roll, less 5% economic loss, plus $350 per suite of other income, per instructions.

Underwritten NOI before reserves is $902,612; NCF after reserves is $900,212. Capitalized at 6.25%, the indicated value is $14.44 million. Debt sizing at the 7.00% floor and 30-year amortization yields a maximum loan of about $9.02 million; after 1% origination, $45k closing costs, and a $7.80 million payoff, the transaction produces approximately $1.09 million net cash out.

sections.heading: Property and suite mix
paragraphs: Manager mapping: Type A = Small suite, Type B = Standard suite, Type C = Large suite (manager-cover). Suite counts: A: 3, B: 3, C: 2; occupied: A: 3, B: 2, C: 2. Areas per roll sum to 176,060 SF. Unit 001 monthly rent is $14,450 per executed lease and certified roll; no free rent or amendments affect it as of the roll date.

sections.heading: Lease and occupancy analysis
paragraphs: Certified detail controls occupancy: 7 active, 1 vacant. Manager headline that counts pending as leased is not used in calculations. No near-term rollover is present; all expirations are 2029-08-31.

Archive roll (2026-06-30) shows slightly lower contractual rents; current certified roll controls. Suite 001 lease and manager correspondence confirm no concessions or unsigned changes affecting rent.

sections.heading: Historical versus underwritten financials
paragraphs: T12 actual collections are $1,262,520 with reported NOI $869,736. Underwritten stabilized income is based on scheduled rent roll annual GPR of $1,402,800, less 5% economic loss plus $2,800 other income, giving EGI $1,335,460.
UW operating expenses include taxes $147,294, insurance $49,098, other recurring $196,392, and management at 3% of UW EGI. Reserves at $300/suite total $2,400.
Resulting UW NOI before reserves is $902,612 versus T12 NOI $869,736 (definitions differ per diligence note). NCF after reserves is $900,212.

sections.heading: Debt sizing and sources/uses
paragraphs: Constraints: 65% LTV, 1.25x DSCR, 9% debt yield. Sizing rate is the greater of note rate 6.10% and floor 7.00% → 7.00%. 30-year amortization, monthly payments.
At cap value $14.44MM, 65% LTV is $9.39MM. DSCR at 7.00% sizing rate limits to $9.02MM; debt yield limits to $10.00MM. Maximum loan is therefore $9.02MM.
Sources/uses: Loan $9.0206MM; less 1% origination, $45k closing, and $7.80MM payoff → net cash out approx. $1.085MM.

sections.heading: Risks and diligence status
paragraphs: Pending counted in occupancy: present in manager headline, but corrected in underwriting (risk flagged).
Near-term rollover: absent; next expirations 2029.
Missing insurance: absent; policy limit and dates provided.
Capital in opex: absent; roof replacement explicitly not included in repairs.
Unsigned rent change: absent; packet says unsigned proposals do not control and correspondence confirms no changes for Suite 001.
Temporary free rent: absent per lease excerpt.
Sizing floor binding: present; 7.00% floor exceeds 6.10% note rate.
Refinance shortfall: unresolved without a target payoff beyond the $7.8MM noted; based on this sizing, there is positive cash out.

rows: Absent given $7.8MM payoff; positive net cash out

sections.heading: Source notes
paragraphs: Manager cover note: unit type mapping A/B/C; headline occupancy counts pending; certified detail controls.
Certified rent roll 2026-08-31: unit counts, areas, statuses, monthly rents, expirations.
Archive rent roll 2026-06-30: prior rents for comparison only.
Lease 001 and correspondence: executed rent $14,450; no amendments or concessions; unsigned proposals do not control.
Operating statement T12 through 2026-08-31: collections, expense lines, and reported NOI; roof replacement treated as capital, not opex.
Insurance record: GL aggregate limit $2,000,000 effective 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30.
Underwriting instructions: loss, other income, mgmt fee, reserves, cap rate 6.25%, loan constraints and rates, sizing on floor 7.00%.
